The ABC HOBBY RC 16823 Hex Ball Wrench 3.0Mm Length 100Mm is a precision tool designed for hobbyists and professionals alike. Its ergonomic design ensures comfort during extended use, reducing hand fatigue and improving accuracy.

Crafted for durability and performance, the ABC HOBBY RC 16823 is perfect for tightening and loosening hex screws in tight or hard-to-reach spaces. The 3.0mm size and 100mm length provide the versatility needed for various applications, ensuring you have the right tool for your project. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, this hex ball wrench will enhance your toolkit and help you complete tasks efficiently.

Details

• Product Material: Steel

• Manufacturer: Abc Hobby

  • Precision 3.0mm hex ball wrench tip for accurate screw fitting
  • 100mm length provides extended reach for hard-to-access screws

  • Lightweight at 90g for easy handling and portability
  • Durable steel construction for long-lasting performance

How to use

Use the ABC HOBBY RC 16823 hex ball wrench by fitting the 3.0mm tip into the corresponding hex screws on your RC models or other equipment. After use, wipe the wrench clean to remove any dirt or residue and store in a dry place to maintain its condition.
